name: China Overseas Property Holdings Limited
summary: China Overseas Property Holdings Limited, founded in 1986 and headquartered in Hong Kong, is an investment holding company that manages properties across Hong Kong, Macau and the mainland. It reports property management, value-added services and car park space trading. Management work such as security, repairs, cleaning and landscaping serves homes, commercial and government buildings and building sites. Until May 2015 it was named China Overseas Management Services International Limited.
